ModMetaData.name: Rimrooms - Async Industries
ModMetaData.author: Operator
ModMetaData.description:
Build an organization that investigates, contains, and profits from unstable spaces beyond a machine gate.
Development build 0.5.2-dev: Async Industries facility, company account, staff hiring, facilities overview, procurement, machine operation, saved AI-01 destination, expeditions, investigation, company research, remembered gate addresses with ordinary crossing between connected spaces, the rule that inhabitants stay in the Backrooms unless our own people carry them back, colonists who haul actual goods through a gate as ordinary work in either direction, doorways deeper in that can be surveyed and recorded as permanently open ways onward, and colonists who carry our own downed people and our dead back through a gate to a bed or a grave. Original Backrooms menu backgrounds show the mod title and loaded version beside the native version information. Gameplay acceptance is pending; this is not a finished campaign release.
Designed for RimWorld 1.6. No DLC or Harmony required by this package. Existing-game-content replacement, the full procedural campaign, further scenarios, RimWorld Together cooperation and optional integrations remain under development. This source checkpoint still contains historical custom gameplay objects being replaced under the project's existing-content policy.
Author: Operator.
